data.name: Retributive Reach
data.description: Treat your reach as 5 feet greater than normal for the purpose of determining whether or not you can make an attack of opportunity. If a creature provokes an attack of opportunity within this area of increased reach, you can expend one use of mythic power to gain a +%1 bonus on the attack roll and damage roll of the attack of opportunity.|MythicLevel
